title: The agent evaluation playbook: Built-in, DeepEval, and AutoEval on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Evaluations
summary: When you deploy an agent, whether it is working is really several questions: did it finish the task, stay on topic, leak data, or skip steps? This post shows how to evaluate agents on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore with built-in, DeepEval, and AutoEval evaluators, and how to match each
reason: A how-to playbook for evaluating agents with built-in, DeepEval, and AutoEval evaluators on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. No new model/version, no research artifact, no business/policy event, and no new open-source tool or framework release — just usage guidance for a proprietary service.
